title: 5 V to 3.3 V regulator
comment: Written by hand. AMS1117 datasheet (Advanced Monolithic Systems, http://www.advanced-monolithic.com/pdf/ds1117.pdf), Application Hints, Stability, p. 4: 22 uF solid tantalum on the output ensures stability for all operating conditions, so C2 = 22uF polarized. The datasheet gives no value for an input capacitor; C1 = 10uF is our choice for input bypass, not a datasheet figure. Pin numbers (1 GND, 2 VO, 3 VI) are from the same datasheet and match the KiCad symbol.
